items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Frenchie Hughes--we called him Frenchie--a young man that I was in Tusko gee with, a saxophone player

ctx.x: I had to pay ten dollars to go into Colorado, with my bus.
See we haven't gotten to the bus yet. So we made that trip and came back in--I'm trying to think who was on my first trip

with me--but anyway, Frenchie Hughes--we called him Frenchie--a young man that I was in Tusko gee with, a saxophone player and Salva Sanders, and believe it or not, if you ever talk to Count, that was Count's idol when he was barn-storming around Tulsa and Oklahoma City. Salva had that little fingering that Count finally perfected and Salva's brother--I'm telling you the truth--
